verdict.rationale: Clerk ships official SDKs (github.com/clerk/javascript and others referenced across docs), OpenAPI spec, official CLI, llms.txt/docs.md for AI consumption, an official MCP server for AI agents, and a first-party SKILL.md agent-skill file — a strong, AI-native official SDK/tooling ecosystem. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation specifically praising SDK quality/completeness (community evidence is mixed/negative on reliability, e.g. clerk-comm-1, clerk-comm-3), and no explicit list of all officially supported languages/frameworks beyond JS.
